question: The Indian player Sunil Chhetri, who received the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 2021, is associated with which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Football**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Sunil Chhetri is one of the most prominent footballers in India**, often regarded as the face of Indian football.
 
• He was honored with the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in 2021**, which is India's highest sporting honor.
 
• Chhetri is the captain of the Indian national football team and has been instrumental in many of their victories.
 
• He is one of the top goal scorers for India, with numerous goals in international matches, placing him among the highest goal scorers in the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award**

 
 
• It is the highest sporting honor in India, awarded annually by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.**
 
• The award is named after hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand.
 
• It is given to sportspersons for their outstanding performances in the field of sports over a period of four years.
 
• The award includes a medallion, a certificate, and a cash prize.
 
 
 
• **Sunil Chhetri's Achievements**
 
 
• Chhetri has been awarded the Arjuna Award and the Padma Shri for his contributions to Indian football.
 
• He has played for several prominent football clubs, including Bangalore FC and Mohun Bagan.
 
• Chhetri is known for his leadership qualities and his ability to score crucial goals in high-pressure situations.
 
 
 
• **Indian Football**
 
 
• Indian football has seen significant growth in recent years, with the emergence of the Indian Super League (ISL).
 
• The ISL has helped in improving the infrastructure and popularity of football in India.
 
• Indian footballers are increasingly getting opportunities to play in international leagues, which is aiding in their development.
